source_text: A flat pass on excerpt IRs returns possible_issue whenever a pattern would have flagged, and it returns possible_issue when an outside-text predicate has no fact in the claim text. That is the checker doing what METHOD requires. Nested layers are how a client feeds the missing window back in and re-checks, instead of leaving every capped row as the last word.
